notes.title: The "Perfect Update" is here! + Access/Change Quality Settings Info
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33628147/1f65aa7c567b85b363832da094c5ea015bda3a2f.png[/img]

This update aims to fix all of the shortcomings of "Giraffe Town" as well as improve the overall quality and experience of the game.

Update changes:

[b]Skippable cutscenes:[/b] I understand that there are some people who don't really care about the storyline and just want to get straight into the game. You can now skip cutscenes so you aren't forced to sit through them. This is also a handy feature for speed runners trying to break the world record for beating "Giraffe Town" in the quickest time. Or, people who just want to replay the game but not have to rewatch the cutscenes. 

[b]Quicker UI:[/b] UI/menus are now quicker and snappier!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] From the start, "Giraffe Town" never really had any major game breaking bugs so, there wasn't anything serious. However, I became aware of a number of small minor bugs that would appear later on in the game. All these bugs have been fixed in this update and I am proud to say that the game is in a very polished state at this point.

And much much more small changes and fixes like these are also in the update. 

This update improves on many areas of the game and fixes the smaller things making it the perfect update. And really, it's the little things that count.

The update is already available as of now. Although these smaller fixes and changes might go unnoticed, I hope that they provide users with an even better "Giraffe Town" experience.

I would like to say that I really do care about the quality I put into my work. I want to provide the best end user experience for the player that I possibly can.

Enjoy, and thank you for playing! :)

-Samer Khatib

PS. Below I explain how to access and change the quality settings for the game.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Access and Change Quality Settings For Giraffe Town:[/b]

By default, the game runs full-screen at 1280x720 on Fantastic. You can access & change these settings by holding down CTRL key while you launch the game.

This config box will come up:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33628147/fa2f0b7cdd8b992bae2ae470fea907d4d9cfe46a.png[/img]

You can change the quality settings to whatever you prefer.

Note: While the game did ship to run at 1280x720 on Fantastic mode by default, these settings may vary for different users depending on previous games played made with Unity engine as those setting previously set are remembered and shared across other games.
